feeds.title: Nialler9
feeds.description: Nialler9 is the most-read Irish music blog. new music site for those interested in the freshest tracks, the best new albums, specially-curated playlists, Irish music news, features, gig guides and much more.

feeds.title: Four/Four Magazine
feeds.description: The world's fastest growing electronic music and club culture website. Starting in April 2016 with the intention of being the go-to place in Ireland for electronic music news and club culture with specialist skills in opinion pieces, breaking news and podcasts.

feeds.title: The Last Mixed Tape
feeds.description: The Last Mixed Tape is an independent music website, based in Dublin and run by music critic Stephen White. T.L.M.T is dedicated to bringing you all the latest news, reviews & interviews from bands and artists working in Ireland at the moment.

feeds.title: The Treble Maker
feeds.description: Keep up with articles on Irish instruments from McNeela Instruments.

feeds.title: Chordblossom
feeds.description: A Northern Irish Music Website featuring Interviews, Music & Live Reviews, Blogs, Mixtapes, News, Photosets More from the NI music scene.

feeds.title: Headstuff
feeds.description: HeadStuff.org is a cultural media website which focuses on high quality writing about film, music, humour, literature, science, history, visual art and topical things. Overall, HeadStuff is consistent and varied in its music blogging. With detailed album reviews, interviews, and mobile-friendly music lists, it's certainly one site any Irish music lover should become familiar with.

feeds.title: No More Workhorse
feeds.description: No More Workhorse is an arts based web site featuring music, film, theatre, books, TV and a variety of one off events.

feeds.title: The Irish World
feeds.description: The voice of the Irish community since 1987. The family newspaper for Irish people in the UK. Including News, Sports, Community and Entertainment.

feeds.title: Thumped.com
feeds.description: A blog about music, events, movies, games and everything else related to the internet.

feeds.title: mp3hugger
feeds.description: mp3hugger is an indie music blog based off the Irish coast towards Iceland. It started in September 2005 to introduce new music to people who may not otherwise get to hear it.

feeds.title: The G-Man
feeds.description: An alternative music blog looking at local (Cork), national (Ireland) and international alternative music. Check in regularly for gig listings, guides, features, interviews, reviews, exclusive streams, playlists, news and more.

feeds.title: Music Under The Mountains
feeds.description: Music Under The Mountains is a festival of traditional music and song established in 1991 as a showcase for the best in traditional performers in Ireland and abroad.

feeds.title: Session Obsession
feeds.description: The Session Obsession blog is owned and operated by Katrina VanTyne. She started this blog to combine her love for writing with her passion for music. Her goal is to connect Irish musicians to other Irish musicians. Wade through this blog and you'll find interviews with musicians, insights, stories about Vermont sessions, and just about anything else music-related.

feeds.title: 909originals
feeds.description: 909originals is a website dedicated to delving into the past and uncovering the stories behind some of the greatest dance music (including house, techno and all other classic derivatives) tracks, people and clubs. Follow the blog to know more about us.

feeds.title: Primal Music Blog
feeds.description: Irish based music blog focusing on all things reverb, resonance, vibration & echo, shoegaze, ethereal dreampop, post-punk, modern psych rock.

feeds.title: Irish Central » Music
feeds.description: The latest stories on Irish music and musicians

feeds.title: Hotpress » Music
feeds.description: The Hot Press Music section offers the latest news, interviews, album reviews, and live performance coverage, focusing on both Irish and international music scenes.

feeds.title: The Thin Air
feeds.description: The Thin Air is an Irish music and culture website and physical magazine that is run by an avid, ever-expanding group of writers, photographers, artists and musicians utterly passionate about the independent music and culture of the island of Ireland and much, much further afield.

feeds.title: ITMA Blog
feeds.description: The Irish Traditional Music Archive (ITMA) is Ireland's premier institution dedicated to preserving and sharing the nation's rich musical heritage. Its Blog section showcases a diverse array of content, including artist tributes, archival discoveries, digitisation projects, and insights into traditional music and dance.

feeds.title: Groovy Chuck
feeds.description: I started GroovyChuck.com because I want to find and promote the best Irish music. I want to like the music because it's kick ass and not just because it's Irish. GroovyChuck Irish Music Blog is my platform to share this talent and help others like me to find some cool music to listen to.

feeds.title: The Old Blog Node
feeds.description: A forum for exploring the wide world of Irish music and culture that aspires to be informed, incisive, and inclusive.

feeds.title: Jazz Ireland Blog
feeds.description: The blog is dedicated to Irish Jazz and to the fans, musicians and venues that support it.

feeds.title: The Bluegrass Ireland Blog
feeds.description: The source for news of bluegrass and old-time music events in Ireland and more authored by Richard Hawkins. Richard Hawkins is also the member of IBMA, IBMM, and BBMA.

feeds.title: Rock Roots: The Irish Rock Music Archive
feeds.description: Rock Roots aims to rescue great records that have been neglected or forgotten, to bring them back to life until they are legitimately re-issued

feeds.title: RØ Music Lifestyle Art
feeds.description: Music art lifestyle, These are the three demons you must slay if you wish to succeed. Follow to get the updates.

feeds.title: Remy
feeds.description: A blog about Irish and international Independent and unsigned music and bands. Music reviews, live reviews, album reviews, interviews.

feeds.title: XS Noize
feeds.description: XS Noize is an independent international consortium of opinionated music lovers founded in 2014 and run by Mark Millar. XS Noize popularity among music lovers has grown rapidly since its inception. Our mission is to provide insightful musical reviews, interviews, timely news and opinion.

feeds.title: Irish Music Daily Blog
feeds.description: A site that celebrates Irish music with lyrics, chords, articles and videos for all the best traditional songs, singers and bands.

feeds.title: Irish Music Magazine
feeds.description: Irish Music Magazine, strives to inform readers and musicians alike, keeping you abreast of all major developments with in the Irish Traditional Music community.
